H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H516: 'Thou must not destroy'; probably the opening words to a popular song
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H623: Asaph, the name of three Israelites, and of the family of the first
H3034: physically, to throw (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to revere or worship (with extended hands); intensively, to bemoan (by wringing the hands)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H5608: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate
H6381: properly, perhaps to separate, i.e. distinguish (literally or figuratively); by implication, to be (causatively, make) great, difficult, wonderful
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H3947: to take (in the widest variety of applications)
H4150: properly, an appointment, i.e. a fixed time or season; specifically, a festival; conventionally ayear; by implication, an assembly (as convened for a definite purpose); technically the congregation; by extension, the place of meeting; also a signal (as appointed beforehand)
H4339: evenness, i.e. (figuratively) prosperity or concord; also straightness, i.e. (figuratively) rectitude (only in plural with singular sense; often adverbially)
H8199: to judge, i.e. pronounce sentence (for or against); by implication, to vindicate or punish; by extenssion, to govern; passively, to litigate (literally or figuratively)
H4127: to melt, i.e. literally (to soften, flow down, disappear), or figuratively (to fear, faint)
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H8505: to balance, i.e. measure out (by weight or dimension); figuratively, arrange, equalize, through the idea of levelling (ment. estimate, test)
H5982: a column (as standing); also a stand, i.e. platform
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H7161: a horn (as projecting); by implication, a flask, cornet; by resemblance. an elephant's tooth (i.e. ivory), a corner (of the altar), a peak (of a mountain), a ray (of light); figuratively, power
H4791: altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft)
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H6677: the back of the neck (as that on which burdens are bound)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H4161: a going forth, i.e. (the act) an egress, or (the place) an exit; hence, a source or product; specifically, dawn, the rising of the sun (the East), exportation, utterance, a gate, a fountain, a mine, a meadow (as producing grass)
H4628: the west (as a region of the evening sun)
H4057: a pasture (i.e. open field, whither cattle are driven); by implication, a desert; also speech (including its organs)
H2088: the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that
H8213: to depress or sink (expectation figuratively, to humiliate, intransitive or transitive)
H3563: a cup (as a container), often figuratively, a lot (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an owl (perhaps from the cup-like cavity of its eye)
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H2560: properly, to boil up; hence, to ferment (with scum); to glow (with redness); to smear with pitch
H4392: full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully
H4538: a mixture, i.e. of wine with spices
H5064: to flow; figuratively, to stretch out; causatively, to pour out or down; figuratively, to deliver over
H389: a particle of affirmation, surely; hence (by limitation) only
H8105: something preserved, i.e. the settlings (plural only) of wine
H4680: to suck out; by implication, to drain, to squeeze out
H5046: properly, to front, i.e. stand boldly out opposite; by implication (causatively), to manifest; figuratively, to announce (always by word of mouth to one present); specifically, to expose, predict, explain, praise
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H1438: to fell a tree; generally, to destroy anything
